speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the cough produce any phlegm or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough for about three months now, and it produces small amounts of white phlegm. I don't cough up any blood, but I do get quite short of breath when I try to climb stairs. speaker: Doctor
text: That is a very specific finding; could you clarify if you have been experiencing fever, abdominal pain, or constipation alongside these respiratory symptoms? Additionally, have you had any recent travel history or contact with individuals suffering from similar illnesses?

text: No, I haven't had a fever, and I don't have any abdominal pain or constipation. I haven't traveled recently or been around anyone sick, but my shortness of breath has been getting worse lately. speaker: Doctor
